name: Sudan

flag.description: Three horizontal stripes of red, white and black, with a green triangle at the hoist.
flag.symbolism: Red stands for the struggle and martyrs, white for peace and optimism, black for Sudan itself, and green for Islam and prosperity.

hook: Sudan is red on top with a green hoist triangle; Palestine, Jordan and Kuwait reverse the order with black or green on top.
trivia: The flag replaced a blue-yellow-green tricolour in 1970.
Sudan has more pyramids than Egypt, built by the ancient Kingdom of Kush around Meroë.
The capital, Khartoum, lies where the Blue Nile and White Nile meet.
